headline: Frequent Rework of Math Types
diagnosis: The recurring theme in the commit messages indicates ongoing changes related to the structure and functionality of the math types, particularly with the introduction of new features and performance improvements. The presence of TODO comments in the code suggests that there are unresolved issues with the migration to a more unified type system, specifically regarding the transition from object-based coordinates to tuple-based coordinates.
plan: Conduct a code review focused on the TODO comments to assess the impact of the migration on existing functionality.
Establish a clear migration plan for transitioning from LocalCoord and GlobalCoord to their tuple-based counterparts, ensuring all dependent files are updated accordingly.
Create a set of unit tests to validate the behavior of the new types and ensure compatibility with existing code, particularly in the context of the recent feature additions.
Schedule a team meeting to discuss the implications of the changes and gather feedback from all authors involved in the recent commits.
owner_hint: Ownership should be shared among the authors of recent commits.
